content: Filling in a form yourself? Once the form is launched, choose Fill or open it to fill in your own copy. Your draft stays in {{inProgress}} until you submit it.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the launched-form badge on the sample form. Fill is a menu action name; {{inProgress}} is the translated name of the In progress folder where drafts are kept.

usage.context:
showInsideSpace &&
 launchHooks &&
 revealStep(
 LAUNCHED_BADGE_SELECTOR,
 t("FormsTour:FormsFillYourselfTitle"),
 t("FormsTour:FormsFillYourself", {
 inProgress: t("Common:InProgress"),
 }),
 callbacks,
 FORMS_TOUR_LABEL,
